impressive.en: That's really impressive. It is. OK. Let's recap the vocabulary we learned in this programme, starting with rejection, which means saying no or refusing an idea or suggestion.
impressive.zh: 那真是太厉害了。确实是。好了，我们来回顾一下本期节目中学到的词汇吧，首先是“rejection”，意思是对某人说不，或拒绝某种想法或提议。

improve.en: Hello, hello, hello, and welcome to English Learning for Curious Minds, by Leonardo English, the show where you can listen to fascinating stories and learn weird and wonderful things about the world at the same time as improving your English.
improve.zh: 大家好，欢迎收听由 Leonardo English 制作的《English Learning for Curious Minds》。在这个节目中，你可以一边收听引人入胜的故事、了解世界上奇妙而不可思议的事物，一边提升你的英语水平。

import.en: Aristocratic meals contained enormous quantities of meat, elaborate dishes, sugar, and imported spices.
import.zh: 贵族的膳食包含大量的肉类、精致的菜肴、糖和进口香料。

import.en: Britain depended on imported food at the time, but German submarines threatened all the ships crossing the Atlantic.
import.zh: 当时英国依赖进口食物，但德国潜艇威胁了所有穿过大西洋的船只。

improvement.en: This was a big improvement in some respects .
improvement.zh: 在某些方面，这是一个巨大的改进。

imagine.en: When people imagine traditional British food, they picture boiled vegetables with potatoes and gravy and mild flavors.
imagine.zh: 当人们想象传统的英国食物时，他们脑海中浮现的是带土豆和肉汁的水煮蔬菜以及温和的风味。

immigrant.en: This isn’t unusual. Most countries around the world have incorporated foods introduced by immigrants.
immigrant.zh: 这并不罕见。世界上大多数国家都融入了移民引入的食物。

immigrant.en: There are so many more examples. Chinese immigrants, in particular, transformed the food of Southeast Asia.
immigrant.zh: 还有更多这样的例子。尤其是中国移民，改变了东南亚的食物。
